data.name: Farmelo
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Farmelo was a name given to warriors who protected and tended to the land. This name embodies the spirit of courage, loyalty, and faithfulness towards the natural world.

in_latin.name: Farmelus
in_latin.meaning: nomen a Graeco derivatum, significans agricola vel ruralis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christianum a Graeco derivatum, significans agricola vel ruralis, originem habens in verbo 'φάρμακον', quod agros colere significat. In early Christian church, nomen huius generis saepe in honorem sanctitatis et devotionis Christi usitatum fuit. Farmelus, qui significare potest 'fidelis agricola', in traditione Christiana exemplum fidei et laboris agricolarum repraesentat. Nomen huius generis in cultura Christiana usitatum est, et multae personas in Ecclesia Christiana cum hoc nomine celebratae sunt.

in_english.name: Farmelo
in_english.meaning: farm or agricultural worker, derived from Greek root
in_english.long_meaning: The name Farmelo is derived from the Greek root 'φάρμακον', meaning 'agricultural worker' or 'farmer'. In the early Christian church, names of this type were often used to honor the sanctity and devotion of Christ. Farmelo, meaning 'faithful farmer', represents an example of faith and the labor of agricultural workers in Christian tradition. This type of name has been used in Christian culture and many individuals in the Christian Church have been celebrated with this name.

pronunciation.biblical: in biblical Greek context, pronunciation would be closer to PHAR-meh-lo

data.cultural_impact: Farmelo is a name that carries the cultural significance of valor and dedication towards nature and the land. It is a reminder of the value of hard work, resilience, and the importance of preserving the natural world for future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: Farmelo speaks to the spiritual concepts of stewardship, honor, and respect towards the natural world. It is a reminder that we, as humans, are part of a larger web of existence and have a responsibility to care for the earth and all of its inhabitants. Farmelo is a name that inspires us to live in harmony with nature, to nurture and protect it, and to recognize the divine presence in the natural world. It reminds us that the land is not just a resource to be exploited, but a precious and sacred gift that deserves our love, respect, and reverence.
